summary: Iteration 4: Testing League Limits (Plan Gratuito) features. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed. Frontend: Navigation login→home→quiniela→leagues working, capacity indicator '👥 1/25' visible in league cards, second league creation correctly returns 400 error with plan gratuito message received by frontend.

integration_issues.issue: Error alert for second league creation is shown via React Native Alert.alert (browser native dialog). The 400 error IS received and Alert.alert IS called with correct message 'Plan Gratuito: solo puedes crear 1 liga. Actualiza a Premium para crear más ligas.' - confirmation from console logs. Native browser alert dialog is not capturable in automated screenshots.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Route ./context/AuthContext.tsx is missing the required default export' and same for FantasyContext.tsx. These are warnings not errors - routing to context files incorrectly configured in Expo Router. Non-blocking for current feature.

action_items: MINOR: Context files (AuthContext.tsx, FantasyContext.tsx) are generating Expo Router warnings about missing default exports - these files should be excluded from Expo Router routing (move to non-routable path or add proper exports). Not blocking current features.
MINOR: LLENA badge (is_full=true) could not be tested via automation since it requires 25+ members. Code logic is verified correct - badge shows when is_full=true from API.
MINOR: Consider adding testID attributes to league cards (capacity indicator, LLENA badge, code buttons) for better testability in future iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend route order is correct: /leagues/{league_id}/availability is registered BEFORE /leagues/{league_id} (GET detail route), verified by test TestAvailabilityRouteOrder - no wildcard capture issue.
max_members=25 (MAX_MEMBERS_FREE) properly included in league_doc during creation.
my-leagues response includes max_members and is_full fields as required.
is_full logic is consistent: member_count >= max_members.

create_unified_league: limit check uses owned_league = await db.private_leagues.find_one({'owner_id': current_user['_id']}) - correctly checks both quiniela and fantasy leagues under same owner limit.
join_unified_league: capacity check uses league.get('max_members', MAX_MEMBERS_FREE) with fallback - handles legacy leagues without max_members field.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (navigation, capacity indicator, error handling all working; LLENA badge untestable without 25 members)

seed_data_creation: Created test users via pytest: TEST_limit_owner1@test.com, TEST_limit_owner2@test.com, TEST_limit_member1@test.com and associated leagues. UI tests created: ui_cap2_test55@test.com, ui_cap3_test44@test.com with their test leagues.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All league limits features are working. Backend has 15 comprehensive tests in /app/backend/tests/test_league_limits.py. Frontend verified: leagues screen at /quiniela/leagues shows '👥 X/25' indicator correctly. Plan gratuito error message is properly displayed via Alert.alert when user tries to create second league. Navigation login→home→quiniela→leagues is fully functional. Note: AsyncStorage does not persist across browser page navigations in web preview mode - all UI tests must be done in a single browser session starting from register/login.
rca_of_issue: No critical bugs found. All 5 implemented features verified: 1) 1 liga limit per owner (400 error with plan gratuito message), 2) 25 member limit per liga, 3) /availability endpoint returns all required fields, 4) my-leagues includes max_members/is_full, 5) frontend shows '👥 X/25' indicator with progress bar.
